## Summary
Audio Switch solves five common desktop audio problems across Windows 10/11 (`net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0` WPF) and Ubuntu/Debian Linux (`net8.0` Avalonia UI self-contained `linux-x64`, zero runtime prerequisites):
1. Fast switching between 3.5mm AUX headphones, Bluetooth headsets, speakers, and microphones without opening system sound settings.
2. Per-app split audio routing (`Apps` tab & 1-click Dual Split): play music (Spotify, Chrome, Brave, Edge, YouTube Music) through wired AUX while Discord / Teams / Zoom voice calls and headset microphone use Bluetooth simultaneously (`AudioPolicyConfig` on Windows; PipeWire/PulseAudio `pactl move-sink-input` / `move-source-output` on Linux).
3. Playing audio to wired AUX headphones/speakers and Bluetooth headphones simultaneously while compensating for Bluetooth A2DP latency (`0–350 ms` circular FIFO buffer on Windows WASAPI loopback; `module-loopback latency_msec` on Linux).
4. Providing an iOS-inspired Dynamic Island floating at the top edge of the active screen: rests unobtrusively, reveals a rounded capsule on hover, and expands when clicked with horizontal click-and-drag sliding across three views: Audio (`Outputs | Microphones | Apps`), Media (`Spotify | YT Music` with auto-launch and pause handoff), and Battery/System.
5. Showing connected-only Bluetooth headset battery percentages (`DEVPKEY_Device_IsConnected` on Windows; `org.bluez.Battery1` / UPower on Linux) alongside laptop charge, RAM, CPU, and clock.

## Installation & Removal
- **Windows**: Per-user install location `%LocalAppData%\Programs\AudioSwitch\AudioSwitch.exe` (no admin required), Windows Settings -> Installed Apps removal (`AudioSwitch.exe --uninstall`). DPAPI-encrypted `settings.dat`.
- **Ubuntu / Debian Linux**: `sudo apt install ./audioswitch_1.3.0_amd64.deb` (installs `/usr/lib/audioswitch/AudioSwitch`, `/usr/bin/audioswitch`, desktop entry; remove cleanly with `sudo apt purge audioswitch`) or extract `AudioSwitch-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `./install.sh` / `./uninstall.sh`. AES-256-GCM encrypted `~/.config/AudioSwitch/settings.dat`.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- How do I play audio on Bluetooth and AUX wired headphones at the same time in Windows 11 without echo?
  Audio Switch uses WASAPI loopback capture on the primary endpoint and feeds checked secondary endpoints through a ring-buffered `0–350 ms` sync delay slider (`170 ms` default) so wired AUX output waits for Bluetooth wireless latency.
- Does Audio Switch need .NET or virtual audio cables like VB-Cable installed separately?
  No. The installer bundles the .NET 8 desktop runtime and native WPF libraries inside one `74.4 MB` self-contained binary and uses native Windows Core Audio APIs rather than virtual audio drivers.
- How much CPU does Audio Switch use in the background?
  At rest, timers and WASAPI peak meters are completely stopped (`~0%` steady CPU; measured `0.047s` CPU over 6 wall-clock seconds).
